info.title: Eternet Release Planner
info.description: Dotnet tool for planning NuGet package releases by dependency impact and publishing waves.

options.name: --package-ids
options.description: --pinned-lines-only releases only the packages with a baseVersion in --version-intent (changed: compared with their line baselines; all: every pinned package). Every other package is packed against its latest stable version on --feed-base-url. Not combinable with --package-ids.

options.name: --expected-source-commit
options.description:
--feed-base-url accepts an HTTP flat-container or a file:// URI for a flat local/SMB NuGet feed; an unreadable directory is not package absence.
eternet-release-planner validate-dependency-closure --source-directory <path> --artifacts-directory <path> [--project-list <path>] [--feed-base-url <url>] [--skip-feed-check]
eternet-release-planner push-waves --plan <path> --artifacts-directory <path> --feed-url <url> --api-key <key> [--reject-duplicates]
eternet-release-planner write-tag-message --plan <path> --manifest <path> --output <path> --tag-name <name>
eternet-release-planner exchange-nuget-oidc --nuget-user <user> [--token-service-url <url>] [--audience <audience>]
